_comment: Drop-in template for a new brand. All <PLACEHOLDER> values must be replaced before deploy. Items marked 'secret: true' go to `wrangler secret put`; items with 'var: true' go in wrangler.toml [vars] section.

brand.name: <BRAND_NAME>
brand.voice_summary: <one paragraph describing brand voice — sensory? technical? warm? professional? — fed into the Claude system prompt>

cloudflare._cron_note: UTC. Pick a time during your owner's working hours so they can review same-day. e.g. 0 19 * * * = 3 PM AST.

GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON.value: <full JSON from a GCP service account; do NOT inline in repo>

GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID.value: <watched folder id; share the folder with the service account email>

_drive_setup_notes: Create a service account in IAM, no roles needed at project level
Share the Drive folder with the service account email as Viewer
If using a Workspace Shared Drive, add service account as a Member

secret.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: <full service role key, NEVER expose to client>

schema_required: blog_posts (with columns: id uuid, title, slug, content text, description, featured_image_url, alt_text, seo_title, seo_description, seo_keywords, reading_time, published bool, source text, auto_draft_meta jsonb)
processed_drive_files (file_id text PK, drive_modified_time timestamptz, blog_post_id uuid, status text, processed_at timestamptz)
cross_post_jobs (id uuid PK, blog_post_id uuid, platform text, status text, platform_post_id text, error_msg text, attempted_at timestamptz, UNIQUE(blog_post_id, platform))
supabase.storage_required: Public bucket named SUPABASE_STORAGE_BUCKET. Images uploaded under auto/<group_key>/<file_id>.<ext>

anthropic._model_notes: Haiku 4.5 fits 700-word bilingual posts in Workers Free 30s budget. Upgrade to claude-sonnet-4-6 if Workers Paid (15-min budget). Opus 4.7 for max quality, slowest.

email_review._setup_notes: Verify the sender domain in Brevo dashboard before sending. EMAIL_LINK_SECRET signs the approve/reject magic links.

secret.META_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN: <permanent Page token derived from long-lived user token>

_setup_notes: Create Meta app at developers.facebook.com → type Business
Add Use Cases: 'Manage everything on your Page'
Owner must be Page admin AND on this FB account
In Graph API Explorer: get short user token → exchange to long-lived → derive Page token via /me/accounts. Page token from a long-lived user token never expires.
Business Manager enrollment unblocks IG publishing for new accounts

secret.META_IG_BUSINESS_ID: <numeric IG Business Account id, derived from /{page-id}?fields=instagram_business_account>

_setup_notes: IG must be Business or Creator account type, linked to the FB Page
Add Use Case: 'Manage messaging & content on Instagram'
Start with META_IG_ENABLED=false. After first post via API, monitor results.
QUIRK: Meta returns 'transient' error on publish even when it succeeds. The Worker handles this by checking recent media post-publish. Without this, you get duplicate posts.

secret.LINKEDIN_AUTHOR_URN: <urn:li:person:XXX for personal OR urn:li:organization:YYY for Company Page (MDP-approved only)>

_setup_notes: Add Products: 'Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect' + 'Share on LinkedIn'
Personal profile posting (w_member_social) works immediately, no review needed
Company Page posting requires Marketing Developer Platform approval (1-4 weeks, can be rejected)
Token lasts ~60 days. Set calendar reminder to re-OAuth before expiry.

feature_flags_summary._explanation: Each platform can be independently flipped. Useful when one is blocked or in cooling-off period.
feature_flags_summary.META_IG_ENABLED: false (true only after first successful test, since new IG accounts may have hidden cooling-off)
feature_flags_summary.LINKEDIN_ENABLED: false (true only after OAuth completes and access token is in secrets)
